svg.text: PORTFOLIO VISUAL OVERHAUL — VARIANT 06 — NOSTROMO CRT

g.text: // 20+ YRS DESIGN :: 15+ YRS CODE :: 35 THEMES :: WCAG AA
Italic serif name (humanizing) over green phosphor
deck. Same trick as the actual Nostromo decal.
half at 55% opacity — sells the design half first.
Existing brand mark redrawn as box-drawing ASCII.
Keeps existing logos, recomposed as terminal panel.
Each card carries an ASCII diagram (route map,
swatch grid, floorplan). Stagger reveal on scroll.
Block cursor only animating element. Scanlines static.
Phosphor green #4ade80 + amber warning #fbbf24 + red critical #f87171 on near-black #050907 deck.
Mostly Courier mono · italic Georgia serif for the name (humanizing) · ASCII box-drawing for diagrams.
Static scanlines + radial vignette + dust speckle + chunky bezel + power LED. Reads: built to last.
Sign-off lands in spec.md § UI Mockup.
